title: teucrium polium subsp. latifolium
intro: Teucrium polium subsp. latifolium, commonly known as Wide-leaved Teucrium or Common Teucrium, is a subspecies of perennial herb that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing pain, preventing infections, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Teucrium polium subsp. latifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects. The plant's therapeutic actions can help in treating various health conditions, including digestive issues, respiratory problems, and wounds.
